signature.one_line: Low-effort repurposing template: near-square footage letterboxed in black 9:16, fixed two-line pain headline on top, plain two-line captions.
unique_devices: Near-square (~1.09:1) footage window at y 24.1-75.9 % on a black 9:16 canvas; the bottom bar stays empty
One fixed 2-line pain-point headline in the top bar for 100 % of runtime, ending on a ~9-frame black frame with only the headline (loop-back)
Plain white 2-line phrase captions (short line over long line) in the bottom quarter of the window, no emphasis
Multi-camera angle changes (front MS, angled MS, tighter MCU) are the only reframes
signature.why_it_works: The headline frames the whole clip as the viewer's problem, so a raw lecture-style recording reads as a reel with near-zero edit effort; the blunt first sentence carries the hook.

hook.first_frame: black 9:16 canvas, fixed white 2-line headline in the top bar, the speaker in a near-square window (medium shot at a whiteboard covered in handwritten notes), 2-line caption near the window's bottom

structure.what: blunt consequence of skipping a step, under the fixed pain headline
name the habit the viewer has, from a second angle
the reframe / fix with a concrete number, one long held shot
the outcome the viewer wants, on tighter angles
black frame with only the headline

pacing.notes: 8 shots; one long hold (~33 % of runtime) for the core lesson; 86 % of cuts read as soft (short dissolves between camera angles, unconfirmed); breath pauses kept

captions.how: Poppins 500 (Montserrat SemiBold closer) 47-48 px, centred, line centres y 61.3 % / 64.3 %; hard-cut phrase swaps 0-4 frames after the first word; no emphasis

background_text.what: fixed 2-line headline in the top bar
background_text.how: Poppins 700 64 px white on black, line centres y 16.7 % / 20.8 %, phrased as the viewer's pain, ends with '!!'

layout.how: footage 1080x995 at y 463-1457 px, black bars above and below

camera.how: front MS / angled MS / tighter MCU; no digital punch-ins

transitions.how: very short dissolve (~4-6 frames) or straight cut on phrase boundaries

end_card.how: footage and captions gone; headline holds for a loop-back

captions_spec.script: latin (as spoken); profanity masked with asterisks

case.caption: sentence case as spoken (a line can start lowercase mid-sentence)

grouping.words_per_caption: 3-7 split over 2 lines (short first line, longer second)
grouping.break: hard-cut swap to the next phrase, no gap

layout.relative_to_window: line centres at 71.8 % and 77.6 % of the footage window's height (bottom quarter of the window, ~11 % H above its bottom edge)
layout.mapping_to_1080x1920: window 1080x995 at y 463-1457 px; caption line centres at y 1177 px and 1235 px

caption.letterform_evidence: wide round o/e/c, geometric y with straight tail, Montserrat-like proportions; the original is ~14 % wider than Poppins (px for width 48-50 vs px for height 42-44)
caption.fit_note: a 3-word second line solved to 47 px (ink 2.34 % H, 41.4 % W); use 47-48 px

headline.calibration_note: a 3-word headline line measured ink 3.28 % H, 78.6 % W; compute expected ink for the user's headline with fit_font.py
headline.position: fixed for the whole video in the top black bar, 2 centred lines: line 1 centre y 16.7 % (x ~11-89 %), line 2 centre y 20.8 % (x ~16-84 %); title-ish case ending with '!!'

animation.entry: hard cut, whole 2-line phrase at once, no fade/scale/slide
animation.timing: ~0-4 frames after the first word of the phrase
animation.exit: hard cut on the next phrase, no gap; the last ~9 frames show only the headline on black

captions_spec.notes: Positions, sizes, colours and frame timings measured on video frames; font names closest matches (unverified); shadow estimated.

other_text_spec.text: 2-line white bold geometric headline in the top black bar: 'Pain point headline / because of this!!' (see captions_spec.type.headline)
no logos, lower-thirds, end card or CTA text

style.look_intent: high-contrast, muted, cool: natural slightly warm skin against a cool blue background, black bars; soft footage acceptable

sound.music: voice only or a very low bed (gap level -22 dB vs speech; ~7 % silence); breath pauses kept

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

catalog_styles.name: Picture-Frame
catalog_styles.role: near-square footage window letterboxed on black

catalog_styles.name: Big-Text Hook
catalog_styles.role: fixed pain headline in the top bar

use_when: repurposing horizontal / square lecture, webinar or workshop footage into 9:16 fast
a single lesson that fits one pain-point headline
no time or assets for graphics or B-roll
multi-camera footage exists (angle changes replace punch-ins)
avoid_when: polished brand content that needs graphics or motion
vertical source footage (the letterbox wastes ~48 % of the screen)
the user wants emphasis or kinetic captions
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B25 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B25.json) to this brand.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour/font for each role; keep the contrast relationship: {{TEXT}} on {{SURFACE}} >= 7:1, captions >= 4.5:1 on the footage with the shadow)
- {{TEXT}} headline + captions - default #FFFFFF
- {{ACCENT}} - default #FFFFFF (this blueprint has no colour emphasis; a brand accent may tint '!!' or one headline word at most)
- {{ACCENT_2}} - none
- {{SURFACE}} letterbox bars - default #000000
- {{CARD_BG}} - none
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}} headline - default Poppins 700 (Montserrat Bold is closer to the original width)
- {{FONT_BODY}} captions - default Poppins 500 (Montserrat SemiBold closer)
- {{HANDLE}} - @handle (optional, small in the empty bottom bar)
- {{LOGO}} - optional, small in the bottom bar

Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps (29.97).

LAYOUT
1. {{SURFACE}} 9:16 canvas; the speaker footage scaled into a near-square (~1.09:1) window 1080x995 px at y 463-1457 px (24.1-75.9 % H), bars above and below.
2. Fixed headline for 100 % of runtime in the top bar: 2 centred lines 'Pain point headline / because of this!!', {{FONT_DISPLAY}} 64 px, {{TEXT}}, no shadow/box; line centres y 16.7 % (x ~11-89 %) and 20.8 % (x ~16-84 %).
3. Cuts move between camera angles (front MS, angled MS, tighter MCU) at a ~111-frame median shot length; allow one long hold for the core lesson; short dissolves or straight cuts on phrase boundaries; no punch-ins, no B-roll, no graphics.
4. End: last ~9 frames black with only the headline (loop-back).

CAPTIONS
5. Latin script, sentence case as spoken, profanity masked with asterisks.
6. 3-7 words per caption split over 2 lines (short line 1, longer line 2), {{FONT_BODY}} 47-48 px, {{TEXT}}, tracking 0, no stroke/box, soft shadow 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5); centred, line centres y 61.3 % and 64.3 % (1177 px / 1235 px), i.e. the bottom quarter of the window.
7. Whole phrase hard-cuts in 0-4 frames after its first word and hard-cuts to the next phrase with no gap; no emphasis, no animation.

GRADE: Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: high-contrast, muted, cool background with natural skin.
SOUND: voice only at about -14 LUFS; keep short breath pauses; no SFX.

VERIFY before rendering (px values were render-verified with Poppins; with Montserrat or another face, adjust px until the numbers match):
a) Render a test frame with the caption "When you" / "KEY WORD" and the headline "Headline here" over the black bar / a dark area.
b) Measure: python video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test render or snapshot> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.25,0.595,0.75,0.627 --ink "{{TEXT}}:60" (caption line 1); --box 0.05,0.15,0.95,0.185 --ink "{{TEXT}}:60" (headline line 1).
c) Required: "When you" ink 2.27 % +-0.5 of H and 22.8 % +-2 of W. For the second caption line and the headline compute expected ink with python video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py --font "<font>" --word "<line>" at 47-48 px / 64 px (headline target ink ~3.3 % H).
